changelog:
- Initial release of the Lead Automation Skill.
- Automates lead scraping using geolocation and Google Places APIs.
- Dynamically generates websites for each lead with templating.
- Integrates SMTP relay services (SendGrid, Postmark) for automated, personalized email outreach.
- Includes automated follow-up sequence with timed reminders for improved engagement.
summary: Automates lead scraping, creates personalized websites, sends targeted emails, and schedules follow-ups to engage and convert potential customers efficiently.
